exposure: uterine artery embolism for cesarean scar pregnancy
endoscopic surgery for cesarean scar pregnancy
transvaginal clearance for cesarean scar pregnancy
finding: Transvaginal clearance for cesarean scar pregnancy was found to be an effective and relatively safe treatment option compared to endoscopic surgery and uterine artery embolism, with shorter surgical time, less blood loss, lower blood transfusion rate, less discomfort, shorter hospital stay, and lower hospital expense.
